summary: 🌿 **FarLands** and **SteadyFrame** fix missing grass in portal previews and gaps when grass rebuilds.
🔥 **QuanChunkLoader** now pauses Eitr radiation in loaded bases while nobody is nearby.
🎨 **ValheimVisuals** limits contact shadows to your own camera and settles which mod controls grass radius.

bullets: Grass now shows in PortalPreview views, and the Ashlands fortress beacon fades out between 1000 and 1500 m (new `Buildings.BeaconDistance` setting).
Fixed grass radius conflicts with other mods such as HD Terrain, and grass no longer vanishes briefly while rebuilding.
Far fires and lamps cost much less performance at big bases, with the same look.
Fixed the Stone Battlements sound effect.
Eitr radiation now pauses in loaded bases while no player is near, so dropped Refined Eitr can't wreck an unattended base (on by default).
New optional setting to hide harmless navmesh log warnings, and the log now explains them.
Grass now shows in PortalPreview views, and no longer vanishes briefly when it rebuilds.
Fixed which mod draws the shared GPU grass when one is switched off.
Contact shadows and sun effects now run only for your camera, not PortalPreview views.
Fixed grass radius ownership between mods, leaving it to HD Terrain-style mods when present.
